simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בְּלִיל (H1098) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: בְּלִיל (bᵉlîyl) means mixed , i.e. (specifically) feed (for cattle) First listed occurrence: Isa 30 24.

definitions.full: H1098. belil בְּלִיל noun masculine Isa 30:24 fodder (Aramaic ; compare Arabic moisture of fresh pasture ) — בְּלִיל 30:24 ; suffix בְּלִילוֺ Job 6:5 ; 24:6 — fodder (strictly, mixed fodder, farrago ) 6:5 ; as growing in field 24:6 compare Isa 30:24 .
